dirmngr_local_stream_socket.description: Path to local Unix stream socket for gpg-agent communication. Use 0 to disable local socket or -1 for default.

dirmngr_ldap_port.description: TCP port to listen on for LDAP queries. Set to 0 to disable LDAP support.

dirmngr_ldap_server_pool.description: Enable automatic LDAP server failover using DNS SRV records (RFC 2782).

dirmngr_ldap_servers.description: List of LDAP servers for certificate lookups. Each item contains the LDAP URL (ldap:// or ldaps://).

url.description: LDAP server URL (e.g., ldap://ldap.example.com or ldaps://ldap.example.com:636).

dirmngr_http_proxy.description: HTTP proxy to use for LDAP/HTTP traffic. Use 'auto' to detect proxy from environment (http_proxy/HTTP_PROXY).

dirmngr_no_allow_dns_cert.description: Disable DNS-based certificate lookup (RFC 4398/6186). Recommended for privacy or restricted networks.

dirmngr_no_allow_ldap.description: Disable LDAP entirely (including DNS SRV-based discovery). Use for air-gapped or non-networked environments.

dirmngr_connection_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for network operations (LDAP, HTTP, OCSP).

dirmngr_max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent network connections (LDAP, HTTP).

dirmngr_cache_validity.description: How long (seconds) to cache certificate responses before revalidation.

dirmngr_ocsp.description: Enable OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol) checks for revocation status. Requires responders or DNS SRV records.

dirmngr_ocsp_responders.description: List of explicit OCSP responder URLs (optional; DNS-based discovery used if omitted).

dirmngr_use_standard_resolver.description: Use system DNS resolver instead of cURL’s built-in resolver (e.g., for systemd-resolved compatibility).

dirmngr_log_file.description: Path to log file (empty = no log file; log to stdout/stderr). Avoid logging to world-readable paths.

dirmngr_verbose.description: Verbosity level (0–3). Each increment adds more debug output. Do not enable in production unless debugging.
